remarks: Welcome to the Amari, a beautifully designed 1,997 sq. ft. home in the sought-after community of Kinglet by Big Lake. Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a main-floor den, and a spacious bonus room, this home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. The open-concept main floor boasts a versatile den, convenient side entrance, and a stylish kitchen complete with a large central island, walk-in pantry, and seamless flow into the dining area and great room, highlighted by a modern electric fireplace. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious bonus room, three well-appointed bedrooms, including the private primary retreat featuring a large walk-in closet and dual-sink ensuite. Surrounded by parks, walking trails, and natural green space, with future schools planned and easy access to Big Lake, West Edmonton Mall, and major amenities, this is an exceptional opportunity to own in one of Edmonton's most desirable new communities. **Photos are representative** (id:67522)
